reviews.title: Be Careful
reviews.text: I have used this app for several years now for staff scheduling.  The app worked as intended and I have had no problems with it.   However, I began to receive unsolicited phone calls for additional services. The calls eventually stopped, however only after repeated requests.   The app and/or business I originally signed up for was purchased by another, what appears to be a much larger platform.  The problem I have is that it is now a major action to cancel this app, as it’s no longer necessary for my company.  In order to cancel, you have to make an appointment for a 30 minute phone meeting, which I’m sure will be an attempt to convince me to keep the app.   The other issue is that of course there are no appointments available until after the next billing cycle begins.  IMO this is done to add the extra month’s revenue.   I would never personally work with any company that does business in this fashion.

reviews.title: UNBELIEVABLY Slow app
reviews.text: It’s actually appalling how insanely slow this app is. Nothing about a scheduling software should be using any computational power, this app shows some letters, numbers, has a few buttons, and is used to manage schedules…. Why is it running like I’m trying to run CAD on my iPhone? It’s 2026 for god sakes and a scheduling app takes minimum 2 minutes to actually open, takes a full minute for the clock in button to actually process, and god forbid you want to look at any information outside of your own schedule or the clock in button, cause that will take 10 minutes to load. Absolutely unacceptable and ridiculous for an app that does absolutely nothing requiring any processing power or intense data usage

reviews.title: was good, now its horrible
reviews.text: I used to love this app, they had a wifget function that would show when your next shift was, the ui was easy to use. and then someone bought it and changed and oh wow its bad. reallll bad, if the app will open, it doesnt remember my login so i have to re enter it almost every time. then it opens to a nonsensical lay out. I work at a bar that closes past midnight and it likes to tell me that i have a shift on the next day post close when i really just work till 2am.  there also used to be a notes function so my manager could relay info to me prior to the shift like if theres and event and they got rid of that too. it felt like before it was designed by people who worked and now it doesnt feel that way at all. right now as I type this, im trying to open this app to see who i work with and im just getting a loading screen... garbage. id rate 0 stars if i could.

reviews.title: No thanks, do your checks first
reviews.text: Comes up as a free app but after creating an account and putting all our info in it then announced it’s only a 14 day trial.  Google search reveals a £2.50 - £3.00 pm pp. When there’s no transparency it’s a major red flag.
